title.zh: 将伊富高省 Alfonso Lista市镇 Pinto描笼涯 Potia 国立中学的名称变更为Pinto 国立中学的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Potia National High School in Barangay Pinto, Municipality of Alfonso Lista, Province of Ifugao to Pinto National High School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of Potia National High School in Barangay Pinto, Municipality of Alfonso Lista, Province of Ifugao to Pinto National High School

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2007/ra_9453_2007.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Separation and Conversion into a National High School. - The name of Potia National High School in Barangay Pinto, Municipality of Alfonso Lista, Province of Ifugao is hereby changed to Pinto National High School.
Effectivity. - This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette.
